item.title: How to build a carousel in Vue
item.description: Image carousels are essential UI components for showcasing multiple images or content cards in a compact, interactive format. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built numerous carousel implementations for e-commerce and portfolio sites. A basic Vue carousel requires reactive state for the current slide index, methods for navigation, and CSS for slide positioning. This approach creates a fully functional carousel without external dependencies.
